floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 16 confirmed; residual mapped to one coupled loop-shape decision (single hoisted base + per-iteration count reload vs my cached count); 3-hypothesis frontier banked

Phantom-16 frame producer pinned to the guard's comparison operand (i < count, not the loop shape); a do-while + that guard makes BOTH scan loops byte-exact at 17, moving the entire residual out of th

frontier.hypothesis: Regime A can be broken into target's shape without falling into regime B: the 17-form needs exactly ONE more live *(u8**)(ctx+0xC) read reaching the preheader while the top guards keep their own read.
frontier.mechanism: The preheader reload exists only when the top guards' slots pseudo is dead at the merge; in target it dies at insn 20, in every regime-A spelling it lives to the preheader. Since the read count is a source-structure property (H2), the lever is the TOP GUARDS' spelling, not the loop's.
frontier.next_probe: Re-spell the two >=0 top guards so their pointer dies at the compare (e.g. per-slot record-pointer locals dead after the compare, or reading each 0x18 field through its own inline ctx read), holding the loop at the alt-candidate form; verify insns 12-26 stay byte-exact and check whether lw a0,12(s2) appears at insn 27.

frontier.hypothesis: Target's move a3,a0 is an uncoalesced register-allocator copy whose survival is caused by a register-preference property our C never creates.
frontier.mechanism: cse replaces a redundant load with a reg-reg copy rather than deleting it; that copy survives only if local-alloc/global-alloc fails to coalesce the two pseudos. LICM is ruled out as the producer.
frontier.next_probe: Read .lreg/.greg from the already-generated tmp/grind/func_80017848/s2/da_S3 dump set and find where our equivalent copy is coalesced away; the answer names the liveness/preference property to create.

frontier.hypothesis: The named-count guard (n = count; i = 0; if (i < n)) is a second, distinct phantom-16 producer that may combine differently with the preheader read count.
frontier.mechanism: It also yields frame 0x40 (score 19) while adding a live count local, which changes what is live across the guard — the exact axis that separates regime A from regime B.
frontier.next_probe: Cross the named-count guard against the regime-B read pattern (all pointer reads fresh from ctx) and measure; a form with frame 0x40, the preheader reload and the copy would close the function.
